source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 19 (book page 273); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Is exercise mein yeh akela sawal hai jis mein kuch prove nahi karna, balke \(x\) ki value nikalni hai. Yeh bilkul kitab ke Example 11 jaisa hai.
Diya kya hai? Do inverse tangents ka jama \(\frac{\pi}{4}\). Nikalna kya hai? \(x\).
Rule kaunsa? Formula (v) se dono terms ko ek \(\tan^{-1}\) banana, phir dono taraf tan lena.
Plan: \(a + b\) aur \(1 - ab\) alag alag nikalna (ghalti kam hogi), equation solve karna, aur aakhir mein har root ko asal equation mein check karna, kyunke Example 11 mein ek root rad (reject) hua tha.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\tan^{-1} a + \tan^{-1} b = \frac{\pi}{4}\), jahan \(a = \frac{2x - 1}{3x - 1}\), \(b = \frac{2x + 1}{3x + 1}\) (\(x \ne \pm\frac{1}{3}\)).
Maloom karna hai: \(x\).
Tareeqa: Formula (v), \(\tan^{-1} a + \tan^{-1} b = \tan^{-1}\frac{a + b}{1 - ab}\), jaise Example 11 mein. Aise formulas kabhi kabhi jhoote roots (false roots) de dete hain, is liye aakhir mein har root ki jaanch zaroori hai.

\(a + b\) nikalein
\[a + b = \dfrac{(2x-1)(3x+1) + (2x+1)(3x-1)}{(3x-1)(3x+1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{(6x^2 - x - 1) + (6x^2 + x - 1)}{9x^2 - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{12x^2 - 2}{9x^2 - 1}\]
Kyun: Common denominator \((3x - 1)(3x + 1)\) liya, jo difference of squares se \(9x^2 - 1\) hai. Upar dono brackets multiply kiye: \((2x - 1)(3x + 1) = 6x^2 + 2x - 3x - 1 = 6x^2 - x - 1\), aur doosra \(6x^2 + x - 1\). Jama karne par \(-x\) aur \(+x\) cancel ho gaye.

\(1 - ab\) nikalein
\[ab = \dfrac{(2x-1)(2x+1)}{(3x-1)(3x+1)} = \dfrac{4x^2 - 1}{9x^2 - 1}\]
\[1 - ab = \dfrac{(9x^2 - 1) - (4x^2 - 1)}{9x^2 - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{5x^2}{9x^2 - 1}\]
Kyun: Upar aur neeche dono products difference of squares hain. Phir 1 ko \(\frac{9x^2 - 1}{9x^2 - 1}\) likh kar minus kiya; \(-1\) aur \(+1\) cancel ho kar \(5x^2\) bacha.
Dhyan dein: \(-(4x^2 - 1) = -4x^2 + 1\); minus bracket ke andar har term par lagta hai.

Formula (v) se jorein
\[\tan^{-1}\dfrac{12x^2 - 2}{5x^2} = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{a + b}{1 - ab}\) mein upar neeche dono ka denominator \(9x^2 - 1\) hai, jo cancel ho gaya.

Dono taraf tan lein aur solve karein
\[\dfrac{12x^2 - 2}{5x^2} = \tan\dfrac{\pi}{4} = 1\]
\[12x^2 - 2 = 5x^2\]
\[7x^2 = 2\]
\[x = \pm\sqrt{\dfrac{2}{7}} = \pm\dfrac{\sqrt{14}}{7}\]
Kyun: \(\tan(\tan^{-1} u) = u\), aur \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\). Cross-multiply kiya, \(5x^2\) left par le aaye, aur square root liya (\(\pm\) dono). \(\sqrt{\frac{2}{7}}\) ko rationalise kiya: upar neeche \(\sqrt{7}\) se multiply karne par \(\frac{\sqrt{14}}{7}\).

Roots ki jaanch
\[x^2 = \dfrac{2}{7}:\ ab = \dfrac{4x^2 - 1}{9x^2 - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{8/7 - 1}{18/7 - 1} = \dfrac{1/7}{11/7} = \dfrac{1}{11}\]
Kyun: Formula (v) bilkul sahi tab hai jab \(ab < 1\). Yahan \(ab = \frac{1}{11}\), jo 1 se kam hai, aur yeh sirf \(x^2\) par depend karta hai, is liye dono roots ke liye ek jaisa hai. Saath hi \(x \ne 0, \pm\frac{1}{3}\). Is liye Example 11 ke ulat yahan koi root rad nahi hota; dono jawab sahi hain.

Tasdeeq: decimals se
\[x \approx 0.5345:\ a \approx 0.1144,\ b \approx 0.7947\]
\[\tan^{-1} a + \tan^{-1} b \approx 0.1139 + 0.6715\]
\[= 0.7854 = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: Calculator se dono sides barabar aayin. \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhne se \(a\) aur \(b\) bas aapas mein jagah badal lete hain, is liye \(x \approx -0.5345\) bhi sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(x = \pm\sqrt{\frac{2}{7}} = \pm\frac{\sqrt{14}}{7} \approx \pm 0.5345\) (dono values equation ko poora karti hain)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 9.2 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har hal hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna proof yahan wale proof se mila kar dekh sakte hain; agar aap ka tareeqa alag hai magar har qadam ki wajah sahi hai, to woh bhi theek hai.
